title: Quantifying Diversity of Thought: A Predictive Law of Weighted LLM Ensemble Lift
abstract: arXiv:2607.17384v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper provides an experimentally verified formal law for calculating the uplift that diversity of thought provides in Large Language Model (LLM) ensembles. From first principles, we derive an exact decomposition of LLM ensemble lift into rescue and damage masses, which yields a compact heuristic for calculating uplift. From this we extract the metrics which predict ensemble performance: an accuracy-adjusted correctness correlation, $\phi_{\mathrm{adj}}$, together with the accuracy gap and collective accuracy of the pair. We test the law on 767,520 inferences from ten open-weight models over two graduate-level science benchmarks, together with a novel agentic cybersecurity benchmark in which each model conducts digital-forensics investigations by multi-turn tool use in a network-isolated sandbox (23,520 graded trials including abstentions); all votes are released openly. translated_title: 量化思维多样性：加权大语言模型集成提升的预测性定律
translated_abstract: 本文提供了一个经实验验证的正式定律，用于计算思维多样性在大语言模型（LLM）集成中带来的性能提升。我们从第一性原理出发，推导出LLM集成提升的精确分解，将其分解为“拯救质量”（rescue mass）与“损害质量”（damage mass），由此得到一个计算提升的简洁启发式公式。从中我们提取出可预测集成性能的指标：准确度调整后的正确性相关性 φ_adj，以及模型对的准确度差距与集体准确度。我们在两个研究生水平的科学基准测试上，利用十个开源权重模型的767,520次推理对该定律进行了检验，并引入一个新颖的智能体网络安全基准测试，其中每个模型在网络隔离的沙箱环境中通过多轮工具调用执行数字取证调查（共23,520次包含弃权选项的评分试验）；所有投票数据均已公开发布。该启发式方法只需在SuperGPQA上以40:60的投票比例校准一次……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从第一性原理推导并实验验证了一个预测性定律，将加权LLM集成的提升精确分解为“拯救”与“损害”两部分，并给出通过准确度调整相关性等指标即可预测集成性能的简洁公式。
en_tdlr: This paper derives and experimentally verifies a predictive law that exactly decomposes weighted LLM ensemble lift into rescue and damage masses, yielding compact metrics—such as an accuracy-adjusted correctness correlation—that forecast ensemble performance.
